def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if text is a palindrome when considering only letters and digits,
    ignoring case and accents. The empty string is considered a palindrome."""
    import unicodedata

    # Normalize to NFKD to decompose accents, then filter non-letters/digits
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    cleaned = ''.join(
        ch.lower() for ch in normalized
        if ch.isalnum() and unicodedata.category(ch)[0] != 'M'
    )
    return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
